artifact: hostile proof audit of compact plateau and absolutely continuous trajectories
scope: Sections 519-676 only; conditional on the preceding activity corollary and weighted drift lemma and on the stated finite-system/measurable-rate assumptions.

claims.statement: For an absolutely continuous path and finite affine minimum, the derivative equals the minimum active directional slope for almost every time, ties included.
claims.basis: Finite gaps exclude inactive labels for small positive increments; right directional derivative is the minimum over active slopes. Intersect differentiability full-measure sets for the path and composition.
claims.limitations: At interval endpoints the two-sided derivative need not exist; this does not affect the almost-everywhere claim. The formula does not assert differentiability at every tie.

claims.statement: The level set K_h={F_h=M_h} is nonempty, closed, convex, compact, and contained in int B_sqrt(h).
claims.basis: Scale/activity premises force every active slope at c to be zero; a zero-slope label of value M_h bounds F_h above. The fixed such label is active on K_h; activity places K_h∩B_h in the inner box. Convexity excludes points outside B_h.
claims.limitations: Depends on the preceding uniform activity corollary and sign-margin relation.

claims.statement: Along a solution in B_h, F_h is nondecreasing; on a segment in B_h∩(P\K_h), its increase is at least delta_h times elapsed time.
claims.basis: Apply the a.e. chain rule, pointwise drift bound for every allowed rate vector and every active slope, then the no-neutral-active-slope lemma and integration.
claims.limitations: Depends on the earlier weighted drift lemma, the positive rate lower bound, and class membership for strict increase.

claims.statement: A solution starting in K_h remains in K_h, is positive, and extends globally.
claims.basis: First-exit contradiction from B_h; compactness of K_h; bounded speed gives a finite-endpoint limit in K_h; Caratheodory local existence at that limit extends the path.
claims.limitations: Requires the standard Caratheodory local existence/uniqueness theorem; its measurable, bounded-rate and local Lipschitz hypotheses hold on compact positive neighborhoods.

claims.statement: A global class solution that stays in B_h from t0 onward enters K_h by t0+W_h.
claims.basis: Compactness gives min_B F_h; integrate strict drift while outside K_h; continuity handles first entry at the endpoint. For W_h=0, all of B_h has plateau value.
claims.limitations: This is conditional on staying in B_h. It does not prove that arbitrary trajectories reach B_h.

claims.statement: Every positive-class solution enters a global common absorber and is permanent.
claims.limitations: No full theorem, priority, external validation, or whole-manuscript correctness claim is made.
